title: zazzle-csharp-indexer features
description: Behaviour that spans the server, the hook and the report.

entities.name: Usage-shaped improvement loop
entities.description: Every call and redirect is recorded locally, agents can say what was missing, and one command turns that into what to build next.
entities.behavior: McpServer logs each tool call with its timing, size, result counts and how the answer was produced; the hook logs each block and each # allow-raw escape; report_gap adds the agent's note; zazzle-csharp-indexer report summarises per tool, per resolution path, run commands, redirected commands, waste signals, errors and the latest gap notes.
entities.outcome: The owner can see which tools agents use, where the index could not answer and what they still do by hand, from real sessions.
constraints: Free-text arguments are hashed unless ZAZZLE_INDEXER_LOG_PLAIN=1.
The log rotates at 20 MiB, keeping one previous file; report reads both.
Everything stays in the state directory; nothing is sent anywhere.

relatedViews.relationship: Reviewing the report, and the hook's redirects that feed it.
